motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of Council be held on Monday, January 30, 2023 immediately following adjournment of the open session in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: 1) Personal matters regarding identifiable individuals 2) Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to litigation 3) Receiving information related to a position or plan to be applied to negotiations
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of Council be held on Monday, January 30, 2023 immediately following adjournment of the open session in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:
1)    Personal matters regarding identifiable individuals

2)    Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to litigation

3)    Receiving information related to a position or plan to be applied to negotiations

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 11:05 a.m.
